implementation_notes: A SwiftPM `Contracts` target both contexts depend on, with the whole package tested in one `swift test` run so any break surfaces at the same moment for both teams.
idiom_name: Contracts target + one `swift test` across the package

pitfalls: Contracts target importing a context target
